name: manual_0c2889
claim: Check a lesson's generalization against the same day's counterexamples before graduating it; a guarantee worded as 'no X arises' needs a search of the session for an X that did arise, and an overclaim is superseded append-only rather than edited in place.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the parallel-analyst lesson said 'no merge conflicts arise' and was graduated hours before a cherry-pick conflict in the same session; the PR review caught it and a superseding lesson narrowed it.
